title: Remove cam housings, camshafts and hydraulic lifters

notices.text: Loosen cam housing/bearing fasteners progressively in reverse of the tightening sequence, a little at a time across the whole housing, so the cam is not bent by uneven spring load. DO NOT use a magnet to lift the lifters out — there is a service bulletin against it because magnetising a hydraulic lifter makes it collect ferrous debris for the rest of its life. Use a suction tool or a lifter grabber. 3.6 SPECIFIC LIFTER SPLIT: the 2002-2008 3.6 uses 12 conventional non-variable lifters in the EXHAUST positions (996-105-041-72) and 12 switchable variable-lift lifters in the INTAKE positions (996-105-255-25) — they are different parts at very different prices, do not mix them up.

steps.text: Remove cam housings, camshafts and hydraulic lifters.

fasteners.name: Camshaft bearing housing / cam cap bolts

stages.label: M96/01 edition: camshaft bearing saddles to cylinder head M6 10 Nm (7.5 ft-lb); flat-base tappet housing to cylinder head M6 10 Nm; cylinder head cover M6 13 Nm (10 ft-lb). Progressive, in the specified sequence.

fasteners.note: The 3.6 (VarioCam Plus) head differs from the 3.4 head. Confirm against the torque book cylinder head page before use.
